name: Protect & Save The Children (P.S. The Children)
legalName: Protect And Save The Children Association of Selangor and Kuala Lumpur
summary: Works only on child sexual abuse in Malaysia: preventing it, stepping in when it happens, and helping survivors recover.
programmes: Case management and access to justice for abused children
Safeguarding training for professionals and communities
impact: 23,000+ adults and professionals trained in safeguarding (website, cumulative)
4,000+ hours of counselling and play therapy (website, cumulative)
beneficiaries: Children and young people affected by sexual abuse, their families and caregivers, educators and child-protection professionals
